Chapter 804: Chapter 17: Astonishing Harvest (Eight Thousand Words, Two Chapters Combined)_4

Chapter 804: Chapter 17: Astonishing Harvest (Eight Thousand Words, Two Chapters Combined)_4

But it was only a matter of not being able to defeat; the difference in strength between them was not considerable.

Originally, it was six against nine; Eight-claw Sovereign and Heavenly Python Divine Master were already at a disadvantage, let alone taking the initiative to attack the opponent’s nest?

A large portion of Seventh Rank Evil Gods cannot maintain their sanity at all times, but Ninth Rank Evil Gods, with their strong Spirit Will, do not have this flaw.

Each Ninth Rank Evil God, in the human world, would be considered a profoundly wise man.

“We can just wait here.”

Heavenly Python Divine Master spoke, “The temporal and spatial fluctuations emitted by this nest will surely attract other Ninth Rank Evil Gods. By then, we can join forces, gather the power of the approaching Evil Gods, and when the time is right, we can storm the nest.”

...

“Of course, we six, belonging to the same Alliance, should cooperate to eliminate other Evil Gods once we breach the nest.”

Heavenly Python Divine Master added.

Upon saying this,

The other Demonic Divine Masters slightly nodded.

With the power of these six Divine Masters, there is indeed a great risk of storming into the Void Creature Nest.

But what if it is ten Demonic Divine Masters? Twenty Demonic Divine Masters?

At that time, they could forcefully enter the nest, and once they manage to suppress the Void Creatures inside, the six of them would then join forces to deal with the other Demonic Divine Masters.

Indeed, Demonic Divine Masters do occasionally form alliances, but if there isn’t sufficient trust, they would definitely be wary of each other and act independently.

Yet, these six Demonic Divine Masters, with prior preparations, could easily temporarily expel those Evil Gods.

Then, they would have ample time to eliminate the nine Void Creatures.

Time passed.

As the aura of the nest dispersed,

More and more Demonic Divine Masters approached.

And with the active suggestion of the Heavenly Python Divine Master and Eight-Handed Lord, the approaching Demonic Divine Masters all agreed to wait for more Demonic Divine Masters before storming the nest.

Anyone who could become a Demonic Divine Master was no fool and understood well that relying on one’s own power alone was hardly enough to tackle the nine same-rank Void Creatures inside the nest.

Only by joining forces could they divide up the nine Void Creatures in the nest.

Of course, the nine Void Creatures would not be enough for these Demonic Divine Masters to divide among themselves, but now was not the time to consider that. The eyes of the Demonic Divine Masters flickered, looking at the distant colossal nest, wondering about something.

“Almost enough.”

“There are already nineteen Demonic Divine Masters.”

“Just one more, and we can jointly attack.”

Heavenly Python Divine Master looked around and spoke.

Waiting until twenty Demonic Divine Masters gathered to storm the nest was their initial plan.

Twenty Demonic Divine Masters, minus these six, would be fourteen, no more, no less.

More than fourteen would be too many variables; even if these six Demonic Divine Masters joined forces, they could not be sure of expulsion, and they might end up having to entice others to join them in splitting the Void Creatures.

As for fewer than fourteen Demonic Divine Masters, they would seem rather weak against the nine Void Creatures possessing home-field advantage, and they could not take down the nest in a short time.

If it dragged on, attracting more Demonic Divine Masters to gather, and they were still battling the Void Creatures inside the nest, there would be even more variables.

It might even end up with others stealing the opportunity.

Thus, gathering twenty Demonic Divine Masters was the goal, not one more or less.

Outside the nest.

Nineteen Demonic Divine Masters stood, waiting for the twentieth Demonic Divine Master to arrive.

As Heavenly Python Divine Master observed the nest, he also released his perception, feeling out whether any Demonic Divine Master was approaching.

Suddenly,

Just then,

Within the range of Heavenly Python Divine Master’s perception, a terrifying aura appeared, like a frighteningly bright sun, swiftly approaching them.

“Another Demonic Divine Master is coming.”

“Such a scorching aura? Who could it be?”

“There are only so many Demonic Divine Masters in the Void Secret Realm; who is this?”

The nineteen Demonic Divine Masters immediately looked towards the rapidly approaching figure.

From the build, this figure was incredibly small, appearing like dust compared to their own colossal forms as Demonic Divine Masters.

But the Demonic Divine Masters on the field showed no hint of underestimation, as the aura released by the other had already proved everything—although Evil Gods are generally huge, there are also those few of small stature.

“It’s Taiyang Divine Master.”

“Taiyang Divine Master, the one who emerged in the past three to five hundred years?”

“It is said that this Divine Master’s power is formidable; among the Ninth Rank Demonic Divine Masters, he is quite famous.”

Immediately a Demonic Divine Master who recognized Lin Yuan spoke hurriedly.

“Taiyang Divine Master?”

“Good, with this Divine Master joining, our assurance of storming the nest will be greater.”

Heavenly Python Divine Master’s spirits lifted, ready to share the split of the Void Creatures with Taiyang Divine Master if they could suppress the nine Void Creatures inside at the fastest speed.

Rumbling.

Lin Yuan swiftly arrived before the nest, glancing at the nineteen Demonic Divine Masters standing not far from the nest.

“Forget it, the Void Creatures are more important.”

Lin Yuan then turned his gaze towards the nest in front of him.

“Taiyang Divine Master.”

Heavenly Python Divine Master immediately transmitted to Lin Yuan: “I wonder if Taiyang Divine Master would be interested in joining us. Inside this nest are nine Divine Master level Void Creatures; by yourself, it might be difficult…”

Heavenly Python Divine Master immediately explained the plan to collaborate, even promising that as long as Taiyang Divine Master followed commands, he would at least get a share of one Void Creature at the end.

The other Demonic Divine Masters looked at Lin Yuan, ready to join forces and attack the nest as soon as Taiyang Divine Master agreed.
